name: OrangeHRM
summary: OrangeHRM has a free open-source Starter edition with a leave management module, and sells an Advanced edition per employee per month on a quote. Its pricing page lists request and approval, a PTO calendar and automated PTO accrual for Advanced, with a 30-day trial. No price is published.

facts.text: The pricing page describes Starter as free and open-source HR software, and says Advanced pricing operates per employee per month and needs a quote through a form.

The comparison table lists Request/Approve Leave, PTO Calendar, Advanced Leave Configuration and Automated PTO Accrual, but marks tiers with unlabeled icons. We could not confirm from the text which sub-features Starter includes.
The 30-day free trial is listed for the Advanced edition, which is the one that needs a quote.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Per employee per month; quote through a form, modules selectable

hiddenCosts: Advanced has no published price, so a buyer cannot compare it before contacting sales.
The pricing page marks features by tier with unlabeled icons, so check in the trial which leave features Starter includes.
